about: A round shield: a board of planks with an iron boss over a centre grip, and a rim. Held in the off hand's fist behind the boss.

hold_class.source: tools/characters/attach_kinds.json (shield's classes); items.ron has no round shield item yet, only its look

hands.source: holding.md section 1: a shield goes in the off hand only

lead.source: D463 and holding.md: the off hand, the right on a left-handed body, turned and never scaled by -1

grip_type.source: D562: strapped, no finger layer; the hand holds the clips' Strap_Grip on the grip bar and the board rides the forearm (terra_walker::strap)

slots.name: board
slots.joins: its frame's origin is the grip (the strapped mount's origin, D546); its boss and rim are full points

slots.name: grip_bar
slots.joins: a round bar along +Y through the board's origin, on its back, across the boss's hole

slots.name: boss
slots.joins: its seat (a full point) on the board's boss point: position, out of the front (-Z) and up

slots.name: rim
slots.joins: its seat (a full point) on the board's rim point; its size the board's diameter

grip.how: the board's origin, where the fist closes on the grip bar behind the boss: the strapped look's origin, its +Y along the bar, its front -Z

edge.how: its face for a block and a bash: the board's rim point (its centre and diameter) and boss point carried through

held.how: the board at the left hip, face out, in the guard (Low_Guard's target, art/animation/shield_targets.json); the arm solved to put the strapped board there

open.why: the targets were captured with the heater (shield_targets.json's shield); the round board's clearance in them is unmeasured

used.how: in sword.shielded: the block (Clear_Block, a parry at its start); a bash is off-heavy in holding.md, not built

open.why: the shield bash and shield.alone (holding.md) have no clips

carried.how: on the forearm at the left side, the upper arm out, 4.4 cm clear of the body (attachment.md Carried); a strapped look is not tipped

stowed.how: on the back, first, a bow or polearm beside it

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step)

blocking.how: the board raised before the chest (Raised_Block's target), the arm solved to it

open.why: captured with the heater: the round board in Raised_Block is unmeasured

animation.how: sword.shielded's shield moves and guards (assets/data/moves/sword.shielded.ron); shield.alone none yet

open.why: shield.alone (bash, block, fists; holding.md) has no clips

mass_kg.source: a planked round shield of 0.8 m (recalled: 3.5 to 5.5 kg); a stand-in until its parts are weighed

head_mass_kg.source: the board with its boss, the stand-in's mass less the bar and rim (about 0.4 kg, recalled)

balance_m.source: a centre grip: the board's centre at the grip

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: a centre grip bar about 3 cm across (recalled); measured when made

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15 for its block and bash: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

head_mass_kg.source: the inertia band at the reference's diameter and balance (the whole 3.03 to 5.54 kg), less the bar and rim's 0.4 kg

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and diameter, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from a stand-in mass; the round board's clearance in the shield targets is unmeasured
